def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = max(set(x for row in grid for x in row),
             key=lambda c: sum(row.count(c) for row in grid))

    # Find a full-length line of color 2.
    if all(grid[r][c] == 2 for r in range(h)):
        c = next(c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == 2 for r in range(h)))
        side = 1 if c + 1 < w and any(grid[r][c + 1] != bg and grid[r][c + 1] != 2 for r in range(h)) else -1
        # Find the object directly on one side of the line.
        start = c + side
        if not (0 <= start < w):
            return grid
        obj = grid[0][start]
        if obj == bg or obj == 2:
            return grid
        edge = start
        while 0 <= edge + side < w and any(grid[r][edge + side] == obj for r in range(h)):
            edge += side
        target = edge + side
        if 0 <= target < w:
            out = [row[:] for row in grid]
            for r in range(h):
                out[r][target] = 8
            return out
        return grid

    if all(grid[r][c] == 2 for c in range(w)):
        r = next(r for r in range(h) if all(grid[r][c] == 2 for c in range(w)))
        side = 1 if r + 1 < h and any(grid[r + 1][c] != bg and grid[r + 1][c] != 2 for c in range(w)) else -1
        start = r + side
        if not (0 <= start < h):
            return grid
        obj = next((grid[start][c] for c in range(w) if grid[start][c] != bg and grid[start][c] != 2), bg)
        if obj == bg:
            return grid
        edge = start
        while 0 <= edge + side < h and any(grid[edge + side][c] == obj for c in range(w)):
            edge += side
        target = edge + side
        if 0 <= target < h:
            out = [row[:] for row in grid]
            out[target] = [8] * w
            return out
    return grid
